definitions.gloss: president, head (of a political party or major organization)
definitions.explanation: The top leader of a political party, central bank, or other major organization. In Japan, most prominently used for the president of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), who typically becomes prime minister.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{総裁|そうさい}が{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: A new party president was elected.

examples.japanese: {自民党|じみんとう}{総裁|そうさい}{選挙|せんきょ}が{来月|らいげつ}{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The LDP presidential election will be held next month.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}の{総裁|そうさい}は{金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}について{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The governor of the Bank of Japan held a press conference on monetary policy.
examples.notes: When referring to a central bank, {総裁|そうさい} is typically translated as 'governor' in English.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese politics, {自民党|じみんとう}{総裁|そうさい} (LDP president) is distinct from {首相|しゅしょう}/{総理大臣|そうりだいじん} (prime minister), though the LDP president usually becomes PM. For central banks, the English equivalent is typically 'governor' rather than 'president'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総裁|そうさい}{選挙|せんきょ}/{総裁|そうさい}{選|せん}: party presidential election
- {党|とう}{総裁|そうさい}: party president
- {日銀|にちぎん}{総裁|そうさい}: Bank of Japan governor
- {総裁|そうさい}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to assume the presidency
